name: Belzenlok
description: Belzenlok is an elder demon freed from the Abyss who led the Cabal of Dominaria and was Liliana Vess's last demonic creditor.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

summary.text: Belzenlok is an elder demon freed from the Abyss who led the Cabal of Dominaria and was Liliana Vess's last demonic creditor.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: The Cabal tried to summon Kuberr but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss, and he demanded they serve him instead.

citations.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He restored the Cabal's power, moved its capital to the Stronghold of Urborg, and began rewriting history with himself as the lead.

citations.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Urborg", section "Under the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He turned Liliana's brother Josu into a lich general to weaken her, and his cleric Sadage insisted the Blackblade's legend be credited to him.

citations.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: Liliana, Gideon and the Weatherlight crew set out to kill him, as he was the final demon holding Liliana's contract.

citations.text: "Dominaria", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.
"Weatherlight Crew". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Outside the Stronghold Gideon lodged the Blackblade in Belzenlok's thigh, and Liliana grabbed the hilt and drained his life, killing him.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

status.text: Belzenlok is dead, killed with the Blackblade, though in the Echoverse he is a living demon ruling the Cabal with Danitha as his right hand.

citations.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Danitha Capashen", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 4560 AR the Blackblade comes into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle, and the Cabal rewrites its origins.
timeline.quote: would come into the possession of the Cabal minion Needle

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon steals the Blackblade from the Cabal vaults and confronts Belzenlok; Liliana's taunting lets Gideon lodge it in the demon's leg and Liliana activates its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul.
timeline.quote: Liliana grasped its hilt and activated its curse, draining Belzenlok's soul

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Reforged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses the Veil on Dominaria to break the lich spell on her brother Josu.
timeline.quote: Liliana used the Veil again on Dominaria

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal captures Josu and makes him a lich dedicated to Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: the Cabal made a lich dedicated to Belzenlok

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's deal with four demons.
timeline.quote: Bolas then brokered a deal with the four demons who would give Liliana her youth and a fraction of her old power back, in exchange for servitude.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sadage insists the sword's legend be credited to Belzenlok rather than another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Belzenlok! Belzenlok forged it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Sadage goes to present the black blade to Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Sadage opened the doors to the worship hall, ready to present the black blade to his chosen master

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits her last demon, Belzenlok, is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok is here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A captured cleric reveals Belzenlok made Josu his servant and commander of his forces.
timeline.quote: He has made your precious brother into his servant, the commander of his unholy forces!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to free Josu and make Belzenlok pay.
timeline.quote: You'll pay for this, Belzenlok,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Belzenlok used Josu to make her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
timeline.quote: He knew if Liliana used the Chain Veil to unmake Josu, it would leave her so weak she wouldn't be able to use it to destroy Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: A Cabal cleric's dementia magic shows Gideon undead versions of his friends Drasus and Olexo.
timeline.quote: They were undead, their bodies mutilated, bloodless corpses, brought here somehow by Belzenlok.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
timeline.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Teferi for a time mage to help them enter the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill Belzenlok and we need a time mage to help us get into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok's Cabal is hailed with a litany of titles.
timeline.quote: "All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . ."

citation.text: Cabal Evangel (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious and was transformed into a maggot by the Demonlord.
timeline.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

citation.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, a Cabal group's spell summons the demonlord Belzenlok, who maims the cabalists and demands they serve him instead of Kuberr.
timeline.quote: the demonlord Belzenlok burst forth from the rift from the Abyss it created

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok restores the Cabal's power, shifting its capital to the Stronghold of Urborg and expanding across Dominaria as a death cult.
timeline.quote: the Cabal shifted their capital to the Stronghold of Urborg

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok is slain by the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok's reign was ended when he was slain by the joint efforts of the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana begin a mission to kill Belzenlok, the final demon holding Liliana's contract.
timeline.quote: Together, they begin a mission to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Dominaria", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal comes under the control of Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: came under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Age of Renewal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold and kills Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: managed to defeat the Cabal's Stronghold and kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok on Dominaria, with Gideon killing him using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: which he ultimately used to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Gideon with Jaya on a skyship; after helping defeat Belzenlok, Jaya agrees to help the Gatewatch against Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: She didn't take the oath, jokingly stating that she was "not a joiner".

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Meeting the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew learns of the Blackblade, planeswalkers reinforce them, and Jhoira returns Teferi's spark powerstone to him; they fight Yargle at the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Jhoira finally found the right moment to hand over the powerstone containing Teferi's spark to its rightful owner

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting Belzenlok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok is killed with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: together they managed to kill Belzenlok

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Belzenlok's Cabal takes the Stronghold and raises it again with Bogardan lava mages.
timeline.quote: he was able to raise it again and reawaken the sleeping volcano

citation.text: "Stronghold (location)", section "Belzenlok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending the Cabal under Belzenlok moves its capital to Urborg, and the panther warriors are nearly wiped out.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok styled himself as "King of Urborg."

citation.text: "Urborg", section "Under the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later Belzenlok takes control of The Cabal, lives in Volrath's ruined stronghold and rewrites history to claim he had been evincar.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok rewrote Dominaria's history, claiming that he had been Evincar instead of Volrath.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot climbs on deck, sees open water, and meets Karn, who tells it the ship is heading to Urborg to destroy Belzenlok in the Cabal's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We are on our way to Urborg, to destroy the demon Belzenlok in the Stronghold of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
timeline.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok appears in the arena to the cultists' chanting, and Whisper orders captives into the pit.
timeline.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok leaves the arena to defend the Stronghold, and Chandra searches for a way to free Gideon.
timeline.quote: Then Belzenlok stood. His voice roared, "Defend the Stronghold!"

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gideon took a deep breath and drew the Blackblade.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok recognizes Gideon as a planeswalker of the Gatewatch and says he knows what is planned for them.
timeline.quote: You. The Gatewatch. I know what's planned for you.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
timeline.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
timeline.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
timeline.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess has Kyashatar reanimated, and the Traveler slays the revenant.
timeline.quote: The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot.
timeline.quote: the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

citation.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Cabal tried to summon Kuberr but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss.
timeline.quote: but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok began rewriting history with himself as lead and subjugated much of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: began the process of rewriting history with himself as the lead

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess used the Blackblade to slay Belzenlok and end his reign.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess used the legendary sword to slay Belzenlok and end his reign

citation.text: "Belzenlok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the rise of the Cabal under Belzenlok, the forest, town and manor succumb to corruption and decay.
timeline.quote: the entire region — forest, town, and manor — succumbed to corruption and decay

citation.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse Danitha becomes Belzenlok's right hand and leads his forces against Benalia.
timeline.quote: Danitha has taken up her father's role as the right hand of Belzenlok

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabal grows in strength under the Demonlord Belzenlok, posing new threats to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: as the cult of the Cabal grows in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok, Dominaria faces new threats

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok's Cabal desecrated the tomb and Belzenlok engraved a warning on the inscription.
timeline.quote: the tomb had been desecrated by Belzenlok 's Cabal

citation.text: "Martyrs' Tomb", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira salvaged the Weatherlight's remains and assembled a new crew to fight Belzenlok's Cabal.
timeline.quote: After salvaging the remains of the Weatherlight , Jhoira set out to assemble a new crew

citation.text: "Weatherlight Crew". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot, which a frog eats and which later grows into Yargle.
timeline.quote: That maggot was eaten by a frog, which later grew into Yargle.

citation.text: "Yargle", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
